question: Which organisation received the 2025 Laureus Sport for Good Award for using football to support social change?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kick4Life**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2025 Laureus Sport for Good Award** was awarded to **Kick4Life** for its pioneering work in using **football** as a vehicle for **social change** and community development.
 
• **Kick4Life** is a world-renowned social enterprise and football club based in **Maseru, Lesotho**, which became the first football club in the world to be dedicated entirely to **social impact**.
 
• Founded in **2005**, the organization focuses on addressing critical social issues in **Southern Africa**, including **HIV/AIDS prevention**, **gender equality**, and **youth employment**.
 
• The award recognizes **Kick4Life's** holistic approach, which includes a **football academy**, **health education** programs, and **vocational training** to empower young people in **Lesotho**.
 
• Through its unique **social enterprise** model, the organization runs the **No. 7 Restaurant** and a **boutique hotel**, redirecting all profits back into its charitable **community programs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Laureus Sport for Good Award:**
 
 
• This category of the **Laureus World Sports Awards** highlights organizations that use the power of sport to end violence, discrimination, and disadvantage.
 
• It was established alongside the main awards in **2000**, inspired by the words of **Nelson Mandela**, who stated that "Sport has the power to change the world."
 
 
 
• **Street League:**
 
 
• This is a leading **United Kingdom**-based charity that utilizes **football** and **dance fitness** to tackle **youth unemployment**.
 
• It helps young people from disadvantaged backgrounds gain **employability skills** and move into **full-time education** or **training**.
 
 
 
• **Right To Play:**
 
 
• Headquartered in **Toronto, Canada**, this international non-profit was founded in **2000** by **Johann Olav Koss**.
 
• It operates in over **15 countries** across **Africa, Asia, and the Middle East**, using various forms of **play** to protect, educate, and empower children.
 
 
 
• **Football for Peace:**
 
 
• A global **diplomatic** and **sports** organization co-founded by **Kashif Siddiqi** and **Elias Figueroa**.
 
• It is supported by the **United Nations** and works to create **neutral territories** to foster dialogue and peace between conflicting **communities** and **cultures**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Impact of Kick4Life:** Since its inception, **Kick4Life** has reached over **250,000 young people** with health testing and life skills education. Its **Lesotho**-based model is considered a global **benchmark** for **sport-for-development** initiatives.
 
• **HIV Prevalence:** The organization operates in **Lesotho**, a country with one of the highest **HIV prevalence** rates in the world (approximately **21%**), making its **health-centric football** curriculum vital for the nation's **demographic health**.
 
• **Sustainability:** The **social enterprise** wing of **Kick4Life** ensures that the project is not solely dependent on **international grants**, fostering **local economic growth** through its hospitality ventures in **Maseru**.
